tasks.label: lunokOS: emulator
tasks.detail: Builds and runs the binary with stdin attached to the terminal. pio -t upload is not used: PlatformIO pipes stdio, so the prompt never shows and the keyboard does not reach the program. The board is required: the bench is the model it is told to be, hardware included (docs/85).

tasks.label: lunokOS: seed emulator disk
tasks.detail: Copies data/apps into emulator/littlefs. Only for a run of a private disk (--flash emulator/littlefs): with no --flash the emulator reads data/ itself.
